title: Some Consequences of the Grunewald-O'Halloran Conjecture for Pseudoquonic Operators
summary: Investigating a recent positive solution of a conjecture of Grunewald and O'Halloran for complex finite dimensional nilpotent Lie algebras, we are in the position to find results of existence and uniqueness for the construction of complex nilpotent Lie algebras of arbitrary dimension via pseudobosonic operators. We involve the so-called theory of the deformation of Lie algebras of Gerstenhaber, in order to prove our main results.
